title.narrative: Marked Oriented Agriculture Programme (MOAP) in Northern Ghana

description.narrative: The EU funded MOAP, object of this Delegated Agreement, has been designed to support auxiliary agricultural infrastructure creation and productive investments in NW Ghana in the fields of planning, productive use and maintenance of the infrastructures through strong community involvement, capacity building of local authorities and entrepreneurs along entire value chains as well as building-up of service delivery systems for farmers. In preparing the ground for infrastructure development and building the capacities of users and local government for its productive use and maintenance, this Project produces ¿soft¿ outputs.
